objective: Refine the existing agent template against Hackathon SBP 2026 before implementation.
context: The challenge is a local interactive banking-credit ranking platform using synthetic AT03 data, SB21 and CINU catalogs, deterministic rankings, three profiles, comparisons, quality reports, exports, and optional grounded AI.
constraints: Use exactly one explicitly selected LLM provider per run.
Do not infer future business requirements.
Do not implement broad code changes until the grill design phase is closed.
Do not create a permanent parallel business-context document.
The indications document prevails over the presentation when they differ.
Do not code until the refined context is reviewed.
evidence: User confirmed read-only SQL, versioned output, and layered testing.
decisions: Use OpenRouter, Ollama, or QVAC through explicit configuration.
Keep future business context deferred to a later session.
Keep provider choice open and explicit; do not prescribe a provider by environment.
Allow the template base, CONTEXT.md, ADRs, and documentation to evolve when the future challenge arrives.
Use an extensible ECharts catalog with deterministic validation, accessibility, and tabular fallback.
Show only “Template ready for the hackathon.” when readiness criteria pass.
Keep the existing Next.js/React, FastAPI/Python, LangGraph, and PostgreSQL architecture.
Use a local profile selector prepared for future authentication.
Preserve original AT03 files and calculation provenance.
Keep official rankings deterministic and use AI only for grounded explanation/exploration.
Support CSV, XLSX, PDF, and JSON exports.
residualRisks: Production asynchronous worker mode is designed but not yet implemented.
Provider-specific QVAC response compatibility must be verified against the deployed QVAC version.
The current implementation does not yet satisfy the full confirmed hackathon baseline; see docs/TEMPLATE_GAP_AUDIT.md.
